owner_authorized: Train a score-conditioned run4test head with frozen accumulators and better data on GPU, then all three controls against the champion.
hypothesis: Fine-tuning the actual eight run4test dense heads with score inputs can learn interactions between board geometry and points that the previous aggregate-feature residual could not represent.

data_plan.referee: Pinned Chess.com client validates every move and terminal
data_plan.split: opening-family hash; no shared rows or opening families across splits
data_plan.targets: actual points outcome plus deeper searched teacher probability; no static teacher labels or invented censored draws

training_plan.selection: one quantization-aware training run; checkpoint selected on validation only; test evaluated once after selection

panel.stopping: Displayed LOS 100.0%/0.0%, complete pending color-reversed pairs and recheck
panel.promotion: three valid WIN controls; otherwise preserve/reject candidate and retain champion
